title: Auditing Learned Dynamics in Weather Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned weather models are experimentally accessible computational systems whose internal representations can be inspected and manipulated. Using sparse autoencoder features from GraphCast, DeepMind's autoregressive weather forecasting model, we test whether causal relevance requires physical semantics, a question that matters for auditing whether AI forecasters used in high-assurance settings rely on reliable mechanisms. We also look at whether physically associated latent directions can be steered to improve extreme-event forecasts, where interventions are applied to the model's internal activations during the rollout. We find that ablating a feature locked to GraphCast's computational mesh increases global geopotential height error despite lacking conventional physical semantics. translated_title: 天气模型中学习动力学的审计
translated_abstract: 学习型天气模型是在实验上可访问的计算系统，其内部表示可以被检查和操纵。利用来自GraphCast（DeepMind的自回归天气预报模型）的稀疏自编码器特征，我们测试了因果相关性是否需要物理语义，这一问题对于审计在高保证（high-assurance）场景中使用的AI预报器是否依赖可靠机制至关重要。我们还研究了与物理相关联的潜在方向是否可以被引导以改进极端事件预报，其中干预是在滚动预报过程中应用于模型的内部激活。我们发现，消融一个锁定在GraphCast计算网格上的特征会增加全球位势高度误差，尽管该特征缺乏传统的物理语义。其次，抑制与对流和低层涡度相关联的特征会削弱预测的热带气旋加深（即预报期间中心气压的下降……）。
tldr: 该论文利用稀疏自编码器对GraphCast天气模型的内部机制进行审计，发现消融缺乏传统物理语义的计算网格特征也会增加位势高度误差，且抑制与对流和低层涡度相关的特征会削弱热带气旋加深的预测，为AI天气预报模型在高保证场景下的可靠性审计与极端事件预报改进提供了新方法。
en_tdlr: This paper audits GraphCast's learned dynamics using sparse autoencoder features, showing that ablating a mesh-locked feature lacking conventional physical semantics increases global geopotential height error and suppressing convection- and low-level-vorticity-associated features weakens predicted tropical-cyclone deepening, enabling reliability auditing of AI weather forecasters in high-assurance settings.
